block.description: **Unarchive** is helpful to extract files from archvie files.

file_name.description: file_name specifies the file name that need to be unarchived.

file_names.description: file_names indicates whar files have been extracted.

excludes.description: inclules specifies which file should not be extracted. It uses regular express to find the files. It is a list

includes.description: inclules specifies which file should be extracted. It uses regular express to find the files. It is a list

filters.description: filters specifies what to be included and excluded

flat.description: flat specifies if the directory should be ignored.

output.description: output specifies where the extracted files to be put.

type.description: type specifies which type of the archive file is to be handled. Valid options are ".zip", ".tar" and ".tar.gz".

block.description: This only supports **ZIP**, **TAR** and **TAR in GZIP** file now. It supports to use **regular expression** to control which file is **included** or **excluded**.
